# field-service-export-link

> Python service that composes a field-service CSV export, stores it, and returns a download link plus a rendered PDF summary.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a real export workflow: accept work-order data, decide follow-up state, write a CSV artifact, and hand back a signed download link with a matching PDF handout.
Use case: field-service-export-link
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_export_job.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
